title: Xiaohan Sun
text:
Assistant Professor








I am an Assistant Professor of Business and Economics at Allegheny College. My research focuses on child well-being, health policy, economics of education, and applied microeconomics. My work examines the impacts of public policies and social programs on health and educational outcomes using applied econometric methods.
I received my Ph.D. in Agricultural and Resource Economics from the University of Connecticut in 2021, an M.A. in Economics from Boston University in 2015, and a B.A. in Economics from the University of Colorado Denver and China Agricultural University in 2014.
